title: Onboard helios-lite-6b v1.0 — performance profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds the initial model metadata, performance profiles, and automated changelog entry for helios-lite-6b v1.0. Motivation: helios-lite is a community-optimal 6B variant with good latency/quality tradeoffs for low-cost production tiers; adding it to the registry enables routing and Dedicated capacity experiments. Changes include model metadata (manifest, tags, validation checks), autogenerated perf profiles for common sequence lengths (32/128/512), quantization compatibility flags, and a changelog template that the release tooling can consume. Also includes small fixes to the perf profile ingestion script to handle variable attention configs and an update to model-validation CI job to run lightweight smoke-inference against the model bundle. Testing performed: local perf runs on p3/mi100 machines, unit tests, and an end-to-end smoke test in the staging registry. Deployment plan: merge to main, let registry automation pick up the new model, run gradual canary routing, and monitor latency/cost dashboards. Checklist: [x] metadata + manifest added; [x] perf profiles generated and validated; [x] changelog entry templated; [x] CI green (after rerun of perf bench); [x] docs snippet added to onboarding guide.
